issues.title: Pin the review baseline and distinguish the three variants
issues.finding: The retained October 17 review pins code b3fb0b35, head 10cb763b and current app 75d06cb. The third branch targets a future contract, not a newer firmware claim.
acceptanceCriteria: Retain exact source SHAs and dates in branch documentation.
Do not describe the October 4 AWS export as a fresh live audit or 1.3.11 as finalized-rep capable.
issues.resolution: Source/branch intent is documented locally; no device behavior is certified.

issues.title: Device-side image authenticity and OTA authorization
issues.finding: Reviewed 1.3.11 accepts unrestricted OTA GATT writes and caller-provided MD5; secure boot/signed-app verification are off. An app login and download hash do not authorize the device writer.
acceptanceCriteria: Agree and independently implement device-side authenticity/authorization controls outside these app branches.
Demonstrate rejection of unauthorized, unsigned and wrong-target images under the agreed design.

issues.title: Post-activation health and recovery
issues.finding: The inactive slot protects a transfer but automatic boot rollback is disabled; a valid image that crashes can require USB recovery.
acceptanceCriteria: Document and bench-test the actual post-activation recovery procedure.
If rollback is chosen, implement and validate boot health/rollback separately; determine bootloader/partition USB requirements.
Remove any blanket promise that every failed update leaves the device operational.

issues.title: Supply a reproducible, uniquely identified update artifact
issues.finding: No signed-off release artifact or source-to-binary bench evidence is supplied by these app scaffolds. Version reuse cannot identify an exact running build.
acceptanceCriteria: Retain immutable padded application .gz, source/build identity, board/partition target, compressed/inflated sizes and both MD5 values.
Pin dependencies, build the intended target and verify its image; do not use factory ZIP, bootloader or partition files for BLE OTA.
Use a unique verified target version/build; do not infer an exact build from a reused version string.

issues.title: Run the physical iOS/Android OTA and workout acceptance matrix
issues.finding: Host fixtures and source review do not prove native Bluetooth timing, sensor behavior, power safety or installed firmware.
acceptanceCriteria: Test each band slot on real iOS/Android through download, transfer, verification, reboot and rediscovery.
Exercise packet loss, duplicate/reordered ACKs, low battery/USB, background/lock/process death, Bluetooth loss, low/changed MTU and power loss at each stage.
Validate post-update start/readiness, two sets, mid-rep hold, STOP, disconnect, Mountain Climbers placement and sensor/battery recovery.
Retain artifact/device/app identifiers and actual results, including failures.

issues.title: Add release/attempt services with authorization and truthful acknowledgements
issues.finding: The October 4 AWS snapshot has no OTA release/attempt model and identifies missing caller ownership checks and success-looking rep resolver responses.
acceptanceCriteria: Re-read live AWS before designing migrations; reuse the existing stack and deployed band_metrics/tut/velocity fields.
Implement authorized immutable release distribution and idempotent attempt state in staging if cloud distribution is selected.
Return confirmed stored values and errors; test cross-user denial, identical retry, conflict and partial-to-complete merge.
Make installed-version observation distinct from transfer completion.

issues.title: Validate foreground lifecycle, navigation and shared BLE exclusion
issues.finding: The shared operation gate, acknowledged workout-command writes, and foreground/lifecycle protections are implemented. Native navigation, background/reconnect timing and cross-screen exclusion still require device validation.
acceptanceCriteria: All app workout/Identify/update commands and connection actions respect one shared update lock.
Keep pending workout data before OTA; prevent starting during capture.
Validate navigation/screen lock/background behavior in native builds and show interrupted/unknown outcomes honestly.
Check completion only after selected-device rediscovery and target identity verification.
issues.resolution: App protections implemented; full acceptance remains open until native/hardware evidence is recorded.
implementedScope: Shared BLE operation gate excludes OTA and workout/Identify operations and guards connection actions.
Workout writes wait for firmware return-code acknowledgement instead of treating a GATT write as success.
Foreground/lifecycle and updater-owned reconnect handling are implemented.
openAcceptance: Run real iOS/Android navigation, screen lock/background, connection loss and simultaneous-action tests.
Verify retained workout data, unknown-outcome recovery and selected-device rediscovery across app interruption.

issues.title: Bootstrap older bands through an approved service process
issues.finding: 1.3.11 is the first reviewed firmware with image transfer; read-only OTA version service on 1.3.9 does not provide the initial update path.
acceptanceCriteria: Detect presence of the required OTA characteristics, not a version string alone.
Show service-update-required for older or unsupported devices.
Document and test USB bootstrap on the intended hardware outside these app branches; do not execute it as part of this work.

issues.title: Integrate and verify the 1.3.11 OTA state machine
issues.finding: The 1.3.11 OTA transport is implemented and its 13 mocked protocol tests pass. This is host state-machine evidence; native timing, hardware recovery and customer release acceptance remain open.
acceptanceCriteria: Encode the exact 22-byte little-endian START; distinguish status constants from ACK values.
Use fixed payload P, window 32, bounded sequence, distinct compressed/image MD5s, and recovery without waiting for an unspecified final ACK.
Retain selected-device identity; cancellation stops being offered before finalization; resolve reconnect state before a new START.
Run protocol unit tests and native integration tests without adding firmware changes.
issues.resolution: Implemented with 13/13 mocked tests passing. The issue remains open for native/hardware acceptance.
implementedScope: Exact 22-byte START, status-before-ACK parsing, fixed-payload/window flow control and bounded sequence guards.
Distinct compressed/image MD5s, retransmission/reconnect logic and no requirement for a final ACK.
Finalization cancellation barrier, selected-device target-version verification and scoped monitor cleanup.
openAcceptance: Run the transport in actual iOS/Android builds with a validated release artifact and both band slots.
Complete physical loss/background/power/recovery acceptance; do not infer signed-image support or rollback from passing mocks.

issues.title: Validate the implemented gated band firmware screen
issues.finding: The band firmware route/UI, default-off pilot gate, local file validator, device identity checks and battery preflight are implemented. Native end-to-end operation and release-service acceptance remain open.
acceptanceCriteria: Show selected band, source/target version, eligible artifact and charge status.
Separate transfer, verification, restart, verified completion, retry and service-required states.
Default the pilot off; do not advertise customer readiness merely because a source branch exists.
Leave other current app behavior visible and document retained issues.
issues.resolution: App route, guarded UI and preflight implementation are present; 8/8 artifact helper tests pass. Native/hardware acceptance is not complete.
implementedScope: Band firmware route and updater UI with explicit transfer/verification/restart/outcome states.
OTA pilot defaults off; selecting or starting an update remains gated.
Local artifact validation and device identity/capability/battery checks before transfer.
openAcceptance: Validate the file-picker, permissions, screen/lifecycle behavior and target identity handling on actual iOS/Android builds.
Provide an approved release artifact and production distribution/eligibility policy; the local pilot UI does not establish a release catalog.
Keep device-side authenticity, rollback and physical verification open under the shared firmware issues.

testEvidence.kind: host artifact tests using application dependencies with independent Node hashes

issues.title: Retain one combined set and band review
issues.finding: The proposed history and feedback components implement Set -> Rep -> both-band details, separate per-metric means and explicit exclusions, while preserving historical score meaning. Native review/capture lifecycle and trustworthy persisted provenance remain acceptance work.
acceptanceCriteria: Expand Set -> original Rep -> both bands in place.
Show independent metrics, units, validity and separate comparable per-metric means.
Keep completed sets accessible during next-set preparation and continue incoming capture while reviewing.
Show partial/unscored and syncing/confirmed-save states distinctly; do not fabricate missing values.
issues.resolution: Core review and movement-summary implementation is present; 20 host tests pass and six JSX modules compile/import-resolve. Full native/capture/persistence acceptance remains open.
implementedScope: Shared HistoryCards and RepFeedbackCard reuse one set/rep/both-band review.
Movement summaries use recorded rep data and preserve existing scores without inventing target adherence.
openAcceptance: Validate reviewing completed sets during next-set preparation without stopping incoming device capture.
Verify partial/sync/confirmed-save behavior against real capture and staging persistence.
Do not infer missing phase, target or firmware provenance for legacy records.

testEvidence.kind: host proposed-movement/history tests: 7 movement, 4 loader, 9 existing; six JSX modules compile/import-resolve

issues.title: Preserve original identity through offline, retry and late-band updates
issues.finding: The retained review identifies arrival-order/retry numbering and success-looking save paths. In-memory pairing alone does not repair durable persistence.
acceptanceCriteria: Allocate stable session/exercise-occurrence/set/rep identities once and persist pending originals before acknowledging retention.
Restart/retry/late-band updates use the same keys and do not duplicate counts.
Propagate write failures and mark Saved only after canonical server acknowledgement.
Test process restart, missing band, final save and conflicting retry against staging.

issues.title: Migrate set keys and metric envelopes compatibly
issues.finding: The deployed set key only supports one row per session/item; the current runner avoids collisions with separate items. New exercise-to-multiple-set grouping needs a coordinated schema plan.
acceptanceCriteria: Preserve deployed AWSJSON and Float support; do not regress velocity to Int.
Use additive precision-preserving values and compatible readers before new envelopes are written.
If normalizing set storage, migrate a versioned key/table and explicit legacy mappings with backup and count reconciliation.
Keep combined-only and version-1 history readable without invented per-band metadata.

issues.title: Define target scoring and comparable summaries
issues.finding: The current score is ROM-only 0/50/100. New target adherence and normalized ratings require their own definitions and immutable target snapshots.
acceptanceCriteria: Version eligible metrics, units, targets and calculation policy per exercise/placement.
Expose eligible/matched/excluded/incomplete denominators; no target means baseline and no target score.
Do not combine unlike raw metrics or treat arm/thigh as bilateral symmetry.
Client and coach summaries agree and preserve historical formula meaning.

issues.title: Track the remaining proposed screen and service scope separately
issues.finding: This branch work adds selected movement/review and integration changes; it does not complete all 31 planning slides, account/payment/trainer flows or their backend repairs.
acceptanceCriteria: Maintain an implemented-versus-open screen inventory against the retained approval ledger.
Do not represent every detailed screen or deployment as accepted by the overall-direction decision.
Carry account, trainer, payment, entitlement, target and history service repairs as explicit work with independent acceptance evidence.

issues.title: Expose complete session/item/set pagination rather than inferring completeness
issues.finding: The proposed history reader can page and deduplicate rep connections, but existing array-only session/item/set APIs do not provide a reliable completeness contract.
acceptanceCriteria: Add compatible items/nextToken connection responses for every required list and paginate end to end.
Preserve orphan rep evidence and visible metadata/query errors rather than silently dropping records.
Verify histories longer than one API page and date/time-zone boundaries; reconcile summaries to unique persisted reps.

issues.title: Implement the transport-unbound finalized-rep normalizer and pairing adapter
issues.finding: The app-side proposed contract adapter validates stable identity, per-band provenance, units/validity and compatible means without inventing a BLE protocol.
acceptanceCriteria: Require exact 0.1-proposed negotiation and capabilities for both bands; never infer support from 1.3.11.
Reject wrong session/set/run/build, conflicting immutable event/sequence/rep identities and malformed metrics.
Suppress identical retries; preserve partial/out-of-order pairing, original numbering and frozen provenance.
Average only matched, valid, compatible metric definitions/phases/placements and preserve decimals.
issues.resolution: 25 host fixture tests passed locally. This resolves only the pure-JavaScript scaffold; no hardware binding, persistence, firmware implementation or production readiness is established.

issues.title: Agree and implement the future immutable completed-rep contract
issues.finding: Proposed 0.1 event fields and capabilities do not exist merely because the app scaffold accepts them. The current 1.3.11 source still emits mutable/ordered updates.
acceptanceCriteria: Agree shared session/exercise occurrence/set/logical-rep identity and per-device event/sequence/run identity.
Finalize every metric before emitting an immutable event; provide units, validity, phase and source build/profile/calibration.
Specify real wire encoding/transport and capability handshake in firmware-owned work.
Retain captured-to-decoded fixture evidence and real device acceptance before enabling the future app route.

issues.title: Provide atomic set closure and explicit final/partial behavior
issues.finding: The future adapter gates on atomic-set-boundary but cannot implement or prove a device reset. A mid-rep hold must not leak phase/timing into the next set.
acceptanceCriteria: Define safe idle closure or explicit final/discard behavior for a partial rep.
Reset phase/timing/peak/feedback state atomically, emit a stable boundary, and maintain original counters.
Bench-test one band advancing before the other and first next-set movement as Rep 1.
Do not enable the advertised capability until evidence confirms implementation.

issues.title: Bind a verified future capability negotiation to real events
issues.finding: The adapter accepts caller-provided negotiation evidence; it contains no discovery, BLE UUID, decoder or cryptographic verifier.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement only against an agreed, actually available firmware wire contract.
Verify both devices' identity/build/capabilities and attach an evidence reference before constructing the adapter.
Keep fixture mode isolated from live device routes; never promote mocked negotiation to verified hardware.
Leave unsupported and current 1.3.11 devices on the current-firmware path.

issues.owner: App persistence engineer + firmware protocol owner
issues.title: Define replay, late-set routing and restart recovery
issues.finding: The adapter is bounded and memory-only, scoped to one set. It cannot retain device events through power loss or route late old-set events on its own.
acceptanceCriteria: Retain accepted originals durably and rebuild the set adapter on app restart without new IDs.
Route late events to their original retained set; never pair an old-set event into the current set.
Specify device retention/replay/gap semantics and sequence restart behavior; unknown gaps stay visible.
Test capacity boundary, app process death, reconnection, old-run packets and already-completed sets.

issues.title: Validate proposed metric definitions and compatibility policy
issues.finding: The proposed adapter supports declared range/duration/angular speed units and conservatively excludes mixed limbs. Those field semantics require agreement and measurement validation.
acceptanceCriteria: Confirm each definitionId, profile, phase and supported conversion against real capture data.
Preserve source clocks and calibration unknowns; do not imply synchronized timing without a synchronization contract.
Agree any future mixed-limb comparison explicitly before relaxing exclusions.
Version any changed event/metric semantics; do not silently reuse 0.1-proposed.
